reuse.why: Parameterises the existing getEditableCategories / category filter so all category-query actions get the flag from one place; copyPreviousMonth keeps its own JS hidden check and receives the flag separately, as the tree already had it outside the shared query.

duplication.why: The include-hidden condition is now written twice, once in the SQL filter builder and once in copyPreviousMonth's JS check, mirroring the tree's existing split between the two selection paths; nothing else is copied and a shared MonthWideArgs type replaces six inline arg types.

placement.why: The flag is resolved in the month-wide selection helpers in budget/actions.ts, where the tree defines which categories month-wide actions touch.

scope.why: Only the six month-wide actions, their argument type and the selection helper change.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow and default-preserving; a future change to the hidden rule still has to be made in both the SQL filter and copyPreviousMonth.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The new flag goes through getEditableCategories for every query-based action; copyPreviousMonth's separate check predates the change.

disguised_duplication.where: The include-hidden check appears in SQL (getEditableCategoryFilter) and in JS (copyPreviousMonth) because the tree already had the two forms; it is not a reshaped copy introduced to hide duplication.
